attractions.notes_base: TICKETS BOOKED for 12:30-14:30 slot. UNESCO World Heritage Site. 45,000+ Buddhist statues carved 5th-6th century across 53 grottoes. Priority grottoes: Caves 16-20 (Tanyao Five Caves — monumental seated Buddhas up to 17m), Caves 5-6 (painted ceilings, Buddha-life relief panels), Caves 9-13 (Five Magnificent Caves). attractions.name_base: Hanging Monastery (悬空寺)
attractions.location_base: Jinlong Canyon, Hunyuan County, Datong, Shanxi (65km south of Datong city)
attractions.location_local: 山西省大同市浑源县大磁窑镇203省道恒山山腰金龙峡
attractions.notes_base: Day 3 afternoon attraction after Yungang Grottoes. Drive ~90km from Yungang (~1.5-2h via 大同绕城高速); buy tickets on-site. One of China's most spectacular architectural achievements: a Buddhist-Taoist-Confucian monastery literally suspended on wooden poles driven into a sheer cliff face, built 1,500+ years ago (Northern Wei dynasty, 491 AD). Only place in China where the Three Teachings (Buddhism, Taoism, Confucianism) coexist in one site. 40 rooms and halls interconnected by plank walkways across the cliff. Views of Jinlong Canyon below. CRITICAL WARNING: Gaode Maps listed the Hanging Monastery as temporarily closed (zanting kaifang). Verify reopening status before visit: check the official WeChat account or call +86-352-8326502. If confirmed open, timed entry groups are strictly limited. Allow 1.5-2 hours on site. Last entry typically 17:00. Return Datong city for dinner after visit.
attractions.notes_local: 第3天悬空寺（云冈游览后下午前往）。从云冈驾车约90公里（经大同绕城高速约1.5-2小时），现场购票。中国最壮观的建筑奇迹之一：北魏时期（公元491年）建于恒山绝壁之上的悬空寺，以木桩嵌入岩石支撑，融佛道儒三教于一寺，四十余间殿堂经悬空栈道相连，脚下是金龙峡谷。重要警告：高德地图曾标注悬空寺为暂停开放（暂停开放）。参观前务必确认恢复开放时间，建议致电+86-352-8326502核实。若确认开放，限时限流严格。游览约1.5-2小时，末班入场一般17:00。参观结束后返回大同市区用晚餐。

attractions.notes_base: PRIORITY 1 city attraction — full day Datong Ancient City walk starts here. One of China's most important Liao dynasty (916-1125 AD) Buddhist temples. Contains the Daxiong Baodian (Great Hero Treasure Hall) — the largest surviving Liao-period Buddhist hall in China — and the Bojia Jiaocang Lou (1038 AD), a wooden scripture library with extraordinary cabinet carvings including the celebrated smiling Bodhisattva known as the Eastern Venus. Allow 1-1.5 hours. Ticket ~65 CNY. Book online for Labour Day holiday. Verified via RedNote (Huayan & Shanhua double temple guide, 179 likes).
attractions.notes_local: 城区优先级1——大同古城全天步行游首站。中国最重要的辽代（916-1125年）佛教寺院之一。大雄宝殿是中国现存最大辽代佛殿；薄伽教藏楼（建于1038年）内有精美壁藏雕刻，以合掌露齿东方维纳斯菩萨像著称。游览约1-1.5小时，票价约65元，五一假期建议网上预约。小红书已验证（华严寺&善化寺双子星游记，179赞）。

attractions.name_base: Shanhua Temple (善化寺)
attractions.location_base: Nansi Street, Ancient City Area, Datong, Shanxi
attractions.location_local: 山西省大同市古城区南寺街
attractions.notes_base: PRIORITY 2 city attraction — visit after Huayan Temple. One of China's best-preserved ancient temple complexes. Originally Tang dynasty, expanded Liao and Jin dynasties (10th-12th century). Contains four surviving Liao-Jin timber structures along a single central axis — the only site in China with all four — illustrating the full architectural transition from Tang to Jin styles. The Sansheng Hall and Great Hero Hall are highlights. Less crowded than Huayan. Allow 45-60 min. Ticket ~40 CNY. Described by RedNote users as a Liao-Jin architecture museum. Verified via RedNote (179 likes).
attractions.notes_local: 城区优先级2——华严寺游览结束后前往。中国保存最完好的古代寺庙建筑群之一，始建于唐代，辽金时期（10-12世纪）扩建。沿中轴线保存有四座辽金木构建筑，是中国唯一一处集齐四座辽金木构的寺院，完整呈现从唐风到金代的建筑演变。三圣殿与大雄宝殿是参观重点，人少清净。游览约45-60分钟，票价约40元。小红书用户称其为辽金建筑博物馆，已验证（179赞）。

attractions.name_base: Du Fu Thatched Cottage (杜甫草堂博物馆)
attractions.location_base: Caotang Road, Qingyang District, Chengdu, Sichuan
attractions.location_local: 四川省成都市青羊区草堂路浣花溪历史文化风景区
attractions.notes_base: [PLAN A - PRIMARY] Morning anchor. The most INFJ, literary, and historically resonant attraction in all of Chengdu. The actual thatched cottage of Tang dynasty poet Du Fu (杜甫), who wrote his most famous poems here during exile (759-762 AD). The site is now a vast museum-garden of bamboo groves, lotus ponds, memorial halls, and inscription stones. Recommended morning visit 08:30-11:30 (~3h) before crowds peak. Key stops: 工部祠 (Ministry Hall with Du Fu's statue), 少陵草堂碑亭 (Stone Stele Pavilion), bamboo corridors — INFJ visitors should sit in the bamboo grove and read. Ticket ~50 CNY. Pairs with nearby 浣花溪公园 (free). Verified via RedNote (清晨草堂美到失语: 2334 likes; 四川杜甫草堂: 1767 likes; 不绕路最全路线: 1169 likes; 万字图解攻略: 885 likes).
attractions.notes_local: [PLAN A - PRIMARY] 早上主打。成都最具INFJ气质的文学圣地。唐代诗人杜甫流寓成都时（759-762年）实际居住的草堂，在此写下最著名诗篇。如今是竹林、荷塘、纪念殿堂和碑刻的博物馆式园林。建议8:30-11:30晨游（约3小时），趁人群未聚集。重点游览工部祠（杜甫塑像），少陵草堂碑亭，以及竹林走廊——INFJ游客可在竹林中静坐读诗。门票约50元，与旁边浣花溪公园（免费）衔接游览。小红书已验证（清晨杜甫草堂美到失语2334赞；四川杜甫草堂1767赞；不绕路最全路线1169赞；万字图解攻略885赞）。

attractions.location_base: 66 Wenshu Yuan Street, Qingyang District, Chengdu, Sichuan
attractions.location_local: 四川省成都市青羊区文殊院街66号
attractions.notes_base: [PLAN C - ALTERNATIVE] Morning anchor 09:00-12:00. Chengdu's most complete and atmospheric Tang-period Buddhist monastery, dating to 605 AD (Sui dynasty) and fully rebuilt in the Qing dynasty. Liang Sicheng called Wenshu Yuan 'a museum of latticed windows (格扇的博物馆)' for its extraordinary carved wooden screens. Key stops: Wenshu Hall (文殊殿) with 1,000-year-old iron statue of Wenshu Bodhisattva; the serene inner courtyard corridors where monks chant at dawn; the red walls that catch morning light. Adjoining the temple is the 香茗茶舍 teahouse area — sit under banyan trees with a bowl of jasmine tea and 糕点 (pastries) before the day begins. Free entry to main temple; incense optional. INFJ note: Chengdu locals visit Wenshu for spiritual grounding, not just sightseeing — join the early-morning crowd of devotees for the most meditative atmosphere. Verified via RedNote (2452 likes speed guide; 1878 likes prayer guide; 472 likes comprehensive guide; 353 likes Buddhist cosmology guide).
attractions.notes_local: [PLAN C - ALTERNATIVE] 上午主打09:00-12:00。成都保存最完整的唐代佛教寺院，始建于605年（隋代），清代全面重建。梁思成称文殊院为「格扇的博物馆」，以精美木雕花窗著称。重点游览：文殊殿（内供千年铁制文殊菩萨像）；僧侣晨诵的幽静回廊；晨光映照的红墙。寺旁香茗茶舍，在黄葛树下享一碗香片茶和糕点，轻松开启一天。主殿免费进入，上香自愿。INFJ特别提示：本地成都人来文殊院寻求心灵安慰而非观光——可融入晨间礼佛人群，体验最沉静的氛围。小红书已验证（速攻攻略2452赞；祈福全攻略1878赞；保姆级攻略472赞；佛教古建宇宙观解读353赞）。

attractions.name_base: Wangjianglou Park - Xue Tao Bamboo Garden (望江楼公园·薛涛竹苑)
attractions.location_base: 30 Wangjiang Road, Jinjiang District, Chengdu, Sichuan
attractions.location_local: 四川省成都市锦江区望江路30号
attractions.notes_base: [PLAN C - ALTERNATIVE] Afternoon continuation 14:00-17:30. One of Chengdu's most underrated literary parks — built to commemorate Tang dynasty poetess Xue Tao (薛涛, 770-832 AD), the first woman poet of Sichuan, who invented the miniature 薛涛笺 (Xue Tao stationery paper) in pink and rose tones. The park sits on the Jinjiang River with the 崇丽阁 (Chongli Pavilion) — a tall multi-story Qing-era tower — reflected in the water. The park contains the world's largest bamboo garden with 120+ species of bamboo (the botanical significance is extraordinary) and is far quieter than tourist hotspots. Key INFJ route: enter via the bamboo grove, walk to the 薛涛纪念馆 (Xue Tao Memorial Hall) and 吟诗楼 (Poetry Chanting Tower), then sit by the river to watch the Jinjiang flow. RedNote notes describe it as 'hidden gem that deserves to be free' and 'national style photography heaven'. Ticket ~20 CNY (free on certain public holidays). Travel from Wenshu by metro Line 4 (~20 min). Verified via RedNote (2133 likes full guide; 1614 likes poetry-rain atmosphere; 1342 likes national-style bamboo photography; 935 likes Yuantaopai TV feature; 617 likes ancient park collection).
attractions.notes_local: [PLAN C - ALTERNATIVE] 下午衔接14:00-17:30。成都最被低估的文学园林，为纪念唐代才女薛涛（770-832年）而建，薛涛是四川第一位女诗人，发明了粉红色薛涛笺。园区坐落于锦江边，崇丽阁高楼倒映水中。园内有全球最大竹种园（120余种竹），较旅游热点安静许多。INFJ路线：入园先穿竹林，走到薛涛纪念馆与吟诗楼，再沿江边静坐看锦江流水。小红书笔记称其为「应该免费的宝藏公园」、「国风拍照天花板」。门票约20元（部分节假日免费）。从文殊院乘地铁4号线约20分钟可达。小红书已验证（完整攻略2133赞；有人等烟雨诗意氛围1614赞；国风竹林拍照1342赞；圆桌派推荐935赞；成都古风公园合集617赞）。

attractions.type_local: 联合国教科文组织世界遗产
attractions.notes_base: [PLAN A - PRIMARY] World's largest stone Buddha (71m), UNESCO listed. Morning session: Take HSR Chengdu East → Leshan (~1h, ~35 CNY). Arrive by 09:00. Combo ticket includes Wuyou Temple (~90 CNY total). Two viewing methods: (1) River boat for full-body frontal view (50 CNY extra, most impressive, book onsite); (2) Walk the cliff stairs 九曲栈道 (Jiuqu plank path) for close-up head-to-toe descent — queue can be 60-90 min in May, start early. Wuyou Temple (乌尤寺) on the small island is included in ticket and far less crowded — a serene Buddhist temple with river views. Complete by 13:00 for onward journey to 五通桥. BOOK TICKETS ONLINE in advance for May (Wechat 乐山旅游 or official site). Allow 3-4 hours total.
attractions.notes_local: [PLAN A - PRIMARY] 世界最大石佛（71米），联合国教科文组织世界遗产。上午段：乘高铁成都东→乐山（约1小时，约35元），09:00前到达。套票含乌尤寺约90元。两种观佛方式：①游船正面观赏全身（另约50元，最震撼，现场购票）；②下九曲栈道近距离从头看到脚——五月排队约60-90分钟，务必早到。乌尤寺在套票内且游客稀少，是有江景的宁静佛寺。13:00前完成，下午前往五通桥。五一务必提前网上购票（微信小程序"乐山旅游"或官方网站）。共约3-4小时。

attractions.location_local: 四川省乐山市五通桥区老街
attractions.notes_base: [PLAN A - PRIMARY] 五通桥 (Wutongqiao) — the 'Little Venice of Sichuan', approximately 25km from Leshan city center (~30-40 min by taxi/bus). A former salt-industry river town on the Mangxi River (茫溪河) with well-preserved Qing and Republic-era riverside architecture, wooden over-water buildings, canal walks, and stone bridges. Almost no foreign tourists. The old street (老街) runs along the river — lined with traditional tea houses, salt merchants' houses, and locals fishing on the banks. Key spots: Mangxi River Bridge (茫溪河廊桥 covered bridge), riverside boathouse tea spots, 西坝豆腐 (Xiba tofu, the area's famous dish — try at a local restaurant). Very 小众, very 舒适 pace. Free to walk. Budget taxi from Leshan ~40 CNY. Allow 2-3 hours.
attractions.notes_local: [PLAN A - PRIMARY] 五通桥——「四川小威尼斯」，距乐山市区约25公里（出租车/公交约30-40分钟，打车约40元）。保存完好的清代及民国茫溪河盐业古镇，木结构临河建筑、沿河石板路、石桥纵横。外国游客极少，极小众。老街沿河延伸，两侧是传统茶馆、盐商旧宅，当地人在河边垂钓。重点：茫溪河廊桥（传统木廊桥）、河边茶摊、西坝豆腐（当地特色菜，在小馆子吃最正宗）。步行免费，节奏极舒适。建议游览2-3小时。

attractions.notes_base: [PLAN B - ALTERNATIVE] 嘉阳小火车 — one of the last operating Republic-era steam narrow-gauge trains in the world (built 1958 for coal mine workers, still using original steam engines). The train runs through forested hills, old coal towns, and countryside for ~20km. Extremely 小众 and photogenic. Departs from 跃进站 (Yuejin Station) in Qianwei County, 芭沟 (Bagou) area. Allow 2.5-3 hours (train + area walk).
attractions.notes_local: [PLAN B - ALTERNATIVE] 嘉阳小火车——全球少数仍在运行的民国窄轨蒸汽火车之一（1958年为矿工建造，至今使用原蒸汽机车）。列车穿越林间丘陵、老煤矿小镇和乡野，行程约20公里。极小众，画面感极强。发车站：犍为县芭沟镇跃进站。距乐山市区约50公里（出租车约1.5小时或包车前往）。发车时间：每日约4班（09:00/11:00/14:00/16:00——出发前务必确认，时刻表按季节调整）。往返票约100-150元，可提前通过"嘉阳小火车景区"微信公众号或大麦网购票。注意：需在10:30前离开乐山大佛以赶上犍为下午班次。摄影控和怀旧爱好者强烈推荐。游览约2.5-3小时。

attractions.location_base: Luocheng Town, Jianwei County, Leshan, Sichuan
attractions.location_local: 四川省乐山市犍为县罗城镇
attractions.notes_base: [PLAN C - ALTERNATIVE] 罗城古镇 — a genuinely mysterious 小众 ancient town with a completely unique layout: the entire main street (船形街) is designed in the shape of a boat, with a covered wooden arcade running the full length, open at the bow end and enclosed at the stern, creating a roofed promenade used by locals as a tea-gathering space for 400 years. The main street is a single long covered wooden shed with Qing dynasty teahouses on both sides — locals sip tea and play mahjong under the wooden roof all day. Almost no foreign visitors. Distance from Leshan: ~45km (~1h by taxi). Free to enter. 高级感 comes from the sheer architectural surreality of the space. Allow 1.5-2 hours. Local 豆花饭 (tofu rice) lunch before exploring. attractions.notes_local: [PLAN C - ALTERNATIVE] 罗城古镇——极小众且神秘的古镇，全镇布局独特：主街（船形街）整体呈船形，上有清代木结构拱廊屋顶全程覆盖，南端为「船头」开口，北端为「船尾」封闭，形成400余年历史的巨型露天茶棚。两侧是清代茶铺，当地人整日在木屋顶下喝茶打麻将。几乎无外国游客。距乐山市区约45公里（打车约1小时）。免费进入。空间的超现实感才是「高级感」所在。建议游览1.5-2小时，顺吃一顿当地豆花饭午饭。

attractions.location_base: Hongxing Middle Road 4 Section, inside Sino-Ocean Taikoo Li, Jinjiang District, Chengdu
attractions.location_local: 四川省成都市锦江区红星中路四段（远洋太古里内）
attractions.notes_base: [PLAN A - PRIMARY] Morning start 10:00-11:30 (~1.5h). A Tang dynasty Buddhist monastery founded in 605 AD, famous as where the Tang monk Xuanzang (玄奘) studied before his westward journey to retrieve Buddhist scriptures. The temple sits dramatically inside the modern Taikoo Li complex, creating a powerful cultural contrast — ancient gilded eaves surrounded by glass boutiques. Free entry. The interior is tranquil with incense smoke, courtyard pines, and original Tang-dynasty layout. Particularly poetic in the morning before the shopping crowds arrive. The contrast with the surrounding luxury mall is its most striking 文艺 quality. Best visited first upon arriving at the 太古里 area, before the shopping energy takes over.
attractions.notes_local: [PLAN A - PRIMARY] 上午10:00-11:30（约1.5小时）。始建于605年的唐代佛寺，著名的是玄奘法师西行取经前曾在此修习。古寺立于现代太古里购物区之中，形成极为强烈的文化对比——唐代金顶飞檐与玻璃精品店并存。免费入场。寺内香烟袅袅，庭院古松，唐代格局保留完整，早晨购物人群未至时最为宁静。抵达太古里后建议先游大慈寺，再漫步商业区。

attractions.notes_base: [PLAN A - PRIMARY] Late morning 11:30-13:00 combined with Daci Monastery (~1.5h total for both). Despite its luxury mall status, the INFJ angle is the courtyard architecture and the hidden alleys (里弄) away from the main luxury shopping axis. The complex is built around the Daci Temple as its spiritual center, with interconnecting lanes of varying width, rooftop terraces, and courtyards. Key move: after visiting Daci Temple, walk the narrow 里弄 (alleyways) on the east and south sides of the complex — these have indie cafes, concept stores, and architectural moments rather than just luxury flagships. The entire complex is low-rise traditional-style architecture with eaves detail, deliberately designed to complement the Tang temple. Free to walk through. Connects directly to Chunxi Road on the north side.
attractions.notes_local: [PLAN A - PRIMARY] 上午晚段11:30-13:00与大慈寺合并游览（共约1.5小时）。虽是奢侈品购物区，INFJ视角在于其院落建筑与隐藏里弄。整个建筑群以大慈寺为精神核心，由宽窄不一的里弄连通，设有屋顶露台和院落。关键路线：游览大慈寺后，走建筑群东侧和南侧的窄里弄——独立咖啡馆、概念小店和建筑细节集中于此，而非奢侈品旗舰店。整体为低矮传统川派建筑风格，飞檐细节与唐代古寺相呼应。免费穿行。北侧直连春熙路。

attractions.notes_base: [PLAN B - ALTERNATIVE] 青城后山 (Qingcheng Back Mountain) is DRAMATICALLY more INFJ and 小众 than the front mountain (前山), which is overrun by tour groups. The back mountain has: (1) 飞泉沟 (Feiquan Gully) — a narrow forested ravine with a cold-water cascade waterfall, dense bamboo, mossy stone steps, and almost no crowds; (2) 又一村 (Yiyicun) — a famous Taoist mountain village tea house at mid-elevation, serving 山泉茶 (spring water tea) in a bamboo pavilion overlooking the forest; (3) 五龙沟 (Wulong Gully) — five interconnected pools and waterfalls in a dense forest. Route: Tai'an Ancient Town (泰安古镇) → Feiquan Gully → Yiyicun tea stop → Wulong Gully → loop back. Total hiking time ~4-5 hours. Ticket ~30 CNY (back mountain separate from front). Take HSR Chengdu → Dujiangyan (~30 min), then bus/taxi to back mountain entrance. Start early (07:30 departure from hotel) to have full day. May is perfect: cool, green, minimal crowds. Verified: RedNote 青城后山 consistently rated top INFJ hiking day trip from Chengdu.
attractions.notes_local: [PLAN B - ALTERNATIVE] 青城后山远比前山更适合INFJ且更小众（前山已被旅游团占据）。后山有：①飞泉沟——狭窄林间峡谷，冷泉瀑布，浓密竹林，青苔石阶，游客极少；②又一村——半山著名道家山村茶社，竹亭中俯瞰林海品山泉茶；③五龙沟——密林中五个相连的水潭和瀑布。推荐路线：泰安古镇→飞泉沟→又一村茶歇→五龙沟→环线返回。总徒步约4-5小时。门票约30元（后山单独售票）。乘高铁成都→都江堰约30分钟，再转公交或出租车至后山景区入口。建议07:30从酒店出发。五月气候凉爽，人少，最佳时机。小红书已验证：青城后山consistently被评为成都周边最适合INFJ的一日徒步目的地。

attractions.notes_base: [PLAN C - ALTERNATIVE] 都江堰 (Dujiangyan) — a 2,300-year-old hydraulic engineering system still in active use, UNESCO listed. Built by Li Bing in 256 BC, it divides the Min River into inner and outer channels using only natural water dynamics — no dam, no sluice gates. The system still irrigates 67 million people today. Key spots: Yuzui (Fish Mouth levee), Feishayan (Flying Sand Weir), Baopingkou (Bottle-Neck Channel). Walk the suspension bridge (Anlan Bridge) over the rushing Min River for atmospheric views. Ticket ~80 CNY. Allow 2.5-3 hours. Take HSR from Chengdu to Dujiangyan station (~30 min). Best combined with Guanxian Ancient City (灌县古城) afternoon walk.
attractions.notes_local: [PLAN C - ALTERNATIVE] 都江堰——公元前256年李冰父子建造的2300年历史水利工程，至今仍在使用，联合国教科文组织世界遗产。依靠纯粹的自然水动力将岷江分为内江和外江，无水坝无闸门，至今灌溉6700万人口。重点游览：鱼嘴、飞沙堰、宝瓶口；走安澜索桥横跨湍急岷江，体验感十足。门票约80元，游览需2.5-3小时。乘成都→都江堰高铁约30分钟。建议下午前往灌县古城漫步搭配。
